protocol.design: Each group uses four separate real-kit cases, one per utility role, with two attacking partners. Same-seed controls swap only partner IDs for outside-group attackers of the same attack shapes, or add 12 growth only to the unchanged focal source.
protocol.timing: Utility kits are deliberately placed immediately before their 12th appearance, aligning 2/3/4-appearance gates. This is not an estimate of natural proc frequency. Layouts are sampled by the unmodified seeded spin.

metricByRole.defense: Own actual healing plus own actual shield generated, resource points.
metricByRole.trainer: Permanent growth actually granted by the focal trainer.
metricByRole.amplifier: Sum of actual recipient multiplier increments above one; flat buffs are separately reported.
metricByRole.disruptor: Actual damage by character-source attackers matching the focal vulnerability filter, not damage causally attributed to the disruptor.

protocol.intervals: Mean intervals use sample SD and a conservative 1.984 standard-error multiplier (t99 for default n=100); activation rates use Wilson 95%. Zero-width deterministic intervals describe this fixed fixture only.
protocol.controls: Outside partners preserve attack role and shape but have different identities; total damage can differ due to base kits, attack self-conditions and normal synergies, so cross-identity damage differences are not attributed solely to support. A queued vulnerability with zero qualifying attackers is not treated as an applied benefit.
protocol.supportOnly: Four real utility roles per group are separately spun at growth zero and growth twelve with no attack roles.
protocol.limitations: One seeded spin per variant in an artificial high-HP fixture. No campaign win rates, natural draft probabilities, endgame power ranking, or global balance/causal claim. All observations use frozen real definitions, never modified or disabled effects.
